# answerui

> A semantic HTML UI framework for FastHTML apps

## Modules

- [answerui.base](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/answerui/base.html.md): The reset, the document on the tokens, and prose
- [answerui.behaviors](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/answerui/behaviors.html.md): The client runtime: delegated event rules that survive htmx swaps
- [answerui.controls](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/answerui/controls.html.md): Native form controls styled through their own states, raised to press and sunken to type into
- [answerui.data](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/answerui/data.html.md): Tables and other displays of structured data
- [answerui.demo](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/answerui/demo.html.md): Isolated rendering of markup with current styles and behaviors, for notebooks and docs
- [answerui.hdrs](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/answerui/hdrs.html.md): App integration: the headers that carry the registry's assets
- [answerui.layout](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/answerui/layout.html.md): Stack, cluster, grid, and document flow
- [answerui.navigation](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/answerui/navigation.html.md): The navbar
- [answerui.overlays](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/answerui/overlays.html.md): Popovers, menus, dialogs, drawers, and tooltips
- [answerui.previews](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/answerui/previews.html.md): Keeping preview frames out of git and regenerating them for the docs
- [answerui.registry](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/answerui/registry.html.md): Defining hyperelements and collecting their styles and behaviors
- [answerui.skill](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/answerui/skill.html.md): Style a FastHTML app with answerui: build pages from its components, change how they look through the registry, and check the result
- [answerui.status](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/answerui/status.html.md): Feedback, loading, and empty states
- [answerui.surfaces](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/answerui/surfaces.html.md): Containers and small pieces of visual information
- [answerui.tokens](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/answerui/tokens.html.md): The styling surface: colour, space, radius, type, motion, and elevation
